items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Two network-clock waits. First, the approved governance waiting-period reduction can execute no earlier than 2026-10-29 18:01 UTC; it is then recorded and restored in the same sitting. Second, the main 39-step flow (9 done) waits for step 10, the first player withdrawal, on 2026-11-03 at or after 13:11 UTC and before 15:37 UTC (the first-week Carried Interest rate). Each clears when its time arrives. No activation of Internet Computer services or real rewards is part of this work.
